query:
FROM logs-falco.alerts-*
| WHERE @timestamp >= "2026-07-27T20:04:23Z" AND @timestamp < "2026-07-27T20:34:23Z"
        AND host.name == "soc-playground"
        AND falco.output_fields.container.id == "a36492b5172b"
| STATS events     = COUNT(*),
        first_seen = MIN(@timestamp),
        last_seen  = MAX(@timestamp)
        BY rule      = falco.rule,
           proc      = falco.output_fields.proc.name,
           cmdline   = falco.output_fields.proc.cmdline,
           parent    = falco.output_fields.proc.pname,
           container = falco.output_fields.container.id
| SORT first_seen ASC

Launch Ingress Remote File Copy Tools in Container
